How to Use Your Medical Card

  1. Present your card at any in-network healthcare provider
  2. For prescriptions, show your card at the pharmacy
  3. In emergencies, provide your card number to hospital staff
  4. Keep your card with you at all times
  5. Report lost or stolen cards immediately
